docs.summary: Editor camera controller with orbit, pan, zoom, and FPS navigation modes. Manages a hidden runtime Camera that renders the scene to a RenderTexture.
Current fly speed.
Time (UnscaledTotalTime) when move speed last changed via scroll. Used for HUD indicators.
World rotation matching the camera's current yaw/pitch.

The point the view is centred on: straight ahead of the camera at the current orbit/zoom distance. "Move to View" drops objects here so they land in front of the camera instead of inside it (where they'd be clipped away by the near plane).
Swaps between perspective and orthographic without changing what is on screen.
docs.remarks: The two are tied together through the focus point: an orthographic half-height of `distance * tan(fov/2)` frames exactly what the perspective view framed at that distance, so the switch reads as a change of projection rather than a jump to somewhere else.

docs.summary: Vertical field of view in degrees, used by perspective views and by focus framing.
Distance to the near clip plane.
Distance to the far clip plane. Orthographic views drive this from the zoom instead.
Half the height the orthographic view covers, in world units.
Fly speed in units per second.
Restores the lens to the defaults a fresh editor camera starts with.
Set the camera position directly.
